questions.q:
Consider the above reaction where $6 . 1g$ of~benzoic acid is used to get $7 . 8g$ of~m-bromo~benzoic acid. The percentage yield of the product is ___ .

(Round off to the Nearest integer)

[Given : Atomic masses : $C = 12 . 0u, H: 1 . 0u, O: 16 . 0u, Br = 80 . 0u$]
questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.solution:
Moles of Benzoic acid $= \dfrac{6 . 1}{122}$

= moles of m-bromobenzoic acid

So, weight of m-bromobenzoic acid

$= \dfrac{6 . 1}{122} \times 201gm$

$= 10 . 05gm$

$%$ yield $= \dfrac{Actualweight}{Theoreticalweight} \times 100$

$= \dfrac{7 . 8}{10 . 05} \times 100$

$= 77 . 61 %$
